EXT. DESERT HIGHWAY - DAY
Heat shimmer. A lone car approaches.

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

MIKE (40s) drives. LUCY (30s) reads a map upside down.

MIKE
Are we lost?

LUCY
(turning the map)
We're not lost. We're exploring.

MIKE
That's what you said in Ohio.

BANG! A tire blows.

The car skids to the shoulder.

CUT TO:

EXT. DESERT HIGHWAY - LATER

Mike kicks the flat tire.

MIKE (CONT'D)
Exploring.
